source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Detect early fluid retention, since rapid weight gain often indicates worsening fluid status before other symptoms become apparent","B":"Tracking mainly long-term weight loss goals, rather than the day-to-day changes related to the client's fluid status","C":"Taking the place of the other symptom monitoring the client would otherwise still need to perform on their own at home","D":"Carrying fairly little established clinical value for a client who is managing ongoing heart failure at home"}}
source_row.rationale: Daily weight monitoring helps detect early fluid retention in heart failure clients, since rapid weight gain (often defined as a specific threshold over a short period) frequently indicates worsening fluid status before other symptoms become apparent, allowing for earlier intervention.
source_row.source_name: AHA — Heart Failure Self-Care and Daily Weight Monitoring
